title: Ultrasound deep learning predicts advanced HCC response to HAIC combination therapy
summary: AE-3DNet, a 3D deep learning model with spatiotemporal attention on pretreatment contrast-enhanced ultrasound cine, was developed in 326 patients with advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (243 for development with fivefold cross-validation, the rest external). It outperformed 3DNet and a time-intensity curve model, with AUC 0.84 and 0.85 in internal and external cohorts. Predicted response survival curves resembled actual outcomes. Dual-center retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data; the external cohort is small.
ai_technology: 3D deep learning (AE-3DNet with spatiotemporal attention modules) on pretreatment contrast-enhanced ultrasound cine images

evidence.tested: External validation cohort within a dual-center study (AUC 0.85) with survival analysis.
evidence.unknown: Prospective use for treatment selection is not established; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep learning model predicted treatment response from pretreatment ultrasound cine.
